findings.evidence: Both proofs are `(… LinearEquiv).finrank_eq.trans (Module.finrank_pi_fintype k)`, and the connected-component equivalence is only the clopen-cover equivalence specialized to `ConnectedComponents.opens`.

findings.evidence: The induction step uses only `eulerCharBelow_succ` and the dimension sum, and both hold for any finite disjoint open cover `U`.
findings.fix: Add `eulerCharBelow_eq_sum_clopenCover (k) (hcover) (hdisj) (M) (n) (hfin : ∀ i < n, ∀ j, FiniteDimensional k (Cohomology ((restrictFunctor (U j).ι).obj M) i))` to `Clopen.lean`, using the same induction with `finrank_cohomology_eq_sum_clopenCover`, and derive the connected-component version as a one-line specialization.
findings.issue: `eulerCharBelow_eq_sum_connectedComponents` is proved only in the connected-component special case. The general finite clopen cover in `Clopen.lean` has the dimension sum but no Euler sum, and `Biproduct.lean` has only the binary `eulerCharBelow_biprod`.

summary: The finite-sum results sit at the wrong level: `finrank_cohomology_eq_sum_connectedComponents` re-proves the general clopen-cover dimension sum, and the truncated Euler sum is proved only for connected components, not for a general finite clopen cover. The rest of the PR sits at the natural level.
